newsitem.title: CANADA: Air Canada, SAS in alliance.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada, SAS in alliance.

text.p: Air Canada and Scandinavian Airlines System said on Friday they agreed to develop a comprehensive air travel alliance that may include code-sharing.
The companies said the pact would further strengthen their respective alliances with UAL Corp's United Airlines and Deutsche Lufthansa AG.

Provisions in the agreement cover such areas as reciprocal participation in frequent flyer programs, schedule coordination, through check-in, reciprocal lounge usage and, subject to government approvals, code-sharing.

The alliance will take effect in 1997, after which the two airlines' schedules and passenger services will be coordinated to provide passengers with one-stop check in and joint flights between Canada and Denmark, and Canada and Norway and Sweden via Franfurt, London and New York.
